conduct.title: Staff conduct
conduct.description: These rules are part of onboarding every moderator.

rules.title: Least access.
rules.text: Open a profile, an account or a document only because a queue item or a support request requires it. The console has no browse members screen on purpose.

rules.title: No curiosity.
rules.text: Looking up someone you know, a public figure, or a profile you matched with as a member is forbidden and is grounds for removal of the role.

rules.title: Identity documents.
rules.text: Every view of a verification request is logged with your name. Never photograph, copy, download or forward an identity image or number. Close the tab when you finish.

rules.title: Chat privacy.
rules.text: You see private messages only as the excerpt inside a report. Never ask a developer for more.

rules.title: Write for the member.
rules.text: Reasons and notes that the member will see must be polite, specific and free of blame. Never name or hint at the reporter.

rules.title: No contact outside the product.
rules.text: Do not phone, message or email a member from a personal account. Support email goes through the shared support mailbox.

rules.title: Conflicts of interest.
rules.text: If a queue item concerns your own profile, a relative or a friend, skip it and tell an admin.

rules.title: Two people for the hardest calls.
rules.text: A ban for fraud, a decision on a possible minor, and any request from law enforcement are confirmed by an admin.

rules.title: Your own account.
rules.text: Use a strong, unique Google account or mailbox for your staff login. Report a compromised staff account to an admin at once.

rules.title: When in doubt, hold.
rules.text: Leave the item in the queue and ask. A late decision is better than a wrong one.

checklist.title: What to check, in order
items: The profile is for one real marriage candidate, not a business, a joke or a test.
Names look like real names in a plausible spelling.
The candidate is 18 or older and the age is plausible against the photos.
Managed by and manager name make sense together.
Each photo follows the photo rules: reject a photo on the spot.
About me, about family and partner notes are suitable: reject a text on the spot.
Short fields (job title, employer, institute, occupations) hold what they should.
No open system report points to a returning banned user.

checklist.finding: Violence, weapons pointed at the camera, hateful symbols

id_document: Readability: every printed field and the photo on the card can be read.
Genuine card: no sign of editing, no pasted photo, not a photo of a screen showing someone else's card.
Number: the number on the card equals the registered number shown here, digit for digit.
Name: the name on the card is the profile's first and last name (spelling variants and a missing middle name are fine).
Date of birth: exactly equals the date of birth of the profile.
Age: the date of birth on the card makes the person 18 or older today.
Gender: the gender on the card matches the profile.
Expiry: the card is not expired today. Lifetime cards pass.
Gesture: the selfie shows today's or yesterday's gesture for this profile.
Face: the person in the selfie is the person on the card and in the approved profile photos.
selfie: The requested gesture is clearly performed.
The face is clearly visible, unedited and unfiltered.
It is the same person as in the primary photo and the other approved photos.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Limits and switches the API reads. A change applies to future actions only: lowering a limit does not undo anything already done.

warning.legal: Every member will be asked to accept the new document the next time they open the app. Publish the new document text first.
warning.photo_review_auto: Photos that pass the automatic check will go live without a person looking at them.

limits.interests_per_day: Interests a profile may send per day (the day starts at midnight in Pakistan).

limits.pending_interests_max: Most sent interests that may wait for an answer at one time.
limits.profile_views_per_day: Different profiles a member may open per day.
limits.messages_per_minute: Chat messages per sender per minute.
limits.messages_per_day: Chat messages per sender per day.
limits.active_connections_max: Active connections per profile. Accepting or sending beyond this is refused.

interest.expiry_days: Days until a pending interest expires.
interest.cooldown_after_decline_days: Days to wait before sending again after a decline.
interest.cooldown_after_expiry_days: Days to wait after an interest expired.
interest.cooldown_after_withdraw_days: Days to wait after the sender withdrew.

connection.cooldown_after_end_days: Days to wait before a new interest after a connection ended.

photo_access.retry_days: Days to wait before asking again after a denial or a revocation.

pass.duration_days: How long a pass hides a profile.

moderation.profile_review: Whether new profiles are reviewed by a person (manual) or go live by themselves (automatic).
moderation.photo_review: Whether photos are reviewed by a person (manual) or go live after the automatic check (automatic).
moderation.text_review: Whether free text is reviewed by a person (manual) or after the automatic check (automatic).

onboarding.identity_required: Whether the identity number step can be skipped.
onboarding.photo_required: Whether at least one photo is needed to finish onboarding.

matching.candidate_pool_size: Candidates fetched from the database per refresh.
matching.recommendations_size: Recommendations kept per profile. Not greater than the pool size.
matching.refresh_hours: Hours after which recommendations are recomputed on the next request.

verification.media_retention_days: Days verification images are kept after a decision.
